crowshotgallery-main-trial.text: Possess a shooter; shoot down all 3 flocks.

openingRound: Action	message	1	A gallery above a lava lake was built for shooting at winged targets, and the hornets that nest on its islets have made it a real hunt. Possess one of your shooters and bring them down.
Action	objectiveid	1	crowshotgallery-o01	Shoot every hornet before time runs out.
Action	order	wait	2	-	Crow1	Crow2	Crow3	Crow4
secondFlock: Action	message	1	A second flock rises from the cracks in the roof.
Action	order	wait	2	-	Raven1	Raven2	Raven3	Raven4	Raven5	Raven6
thirdFlock: Action	message	1	The last flock is the biggest, and winged lizards roost with it.
Action	order	wait	2	-	Rook1	Rook2	Rook3	Rook4	Rook5	Rook6	Rook7	Rook8
galleryClear: Action	message	1	Not a wing is left over the lava. The gallery is yours and the heart has given you a shard.

route: Protect the heart. The existing deadline starts at openingRound (time3) and remains 420 seconds after that trigger, not 420 seconds from loading. spellPossess is already unlocked; starting mana300 and normal heart income are retained.

Possess a level3 starting LizardMan and land at least one real positive projectile hit. All 18 fixed targets must die from own creature projectiles; a hit or lethal knockout alone never counts as death. Other own shooters may assist with projectile kills. Melee, traps, spells cast by the keeper, conversion or environmental deaths do not substitute.

First kill Crow1..4. secondFlock starts after time10 and the first flock is gone, spawning Raven1..6. thirdFlock requires flock2 cleared and spawns Rook1..6 plus Wyverns Rook7/8. Every actual spawn action must have its observed instances dead.

The level3 LizardMan has MissileLaunch range7 and level minimum1. Every target coordinate has a reachable initially open dry shooting position within that range; exact points are in the fixture. This is a necessary spatial check, not a 420-second combat proof.

For the optional goal keep Shooter1..5 alive through the main completion. A real death permanently fails survival; knockout alone does not. Wrong target deaths fail the shot challenge explicitly, and the original timeout still ends the level. Victory narration is guarded by the same shot requirements so it cannot announce a shard for an invalid clear.
CrowshotGallery.runtime_limit: Actual aiming, target movement, damage/cadence, the 420-second route and save/load still require integrator/Mario runtime verification; no playthrough claimed.
